description: List deduplicator (exact, normalized, near-duplicate) — Deduplicate a list of strings: items= separated by new lines or sep= (auto-detects | and ;). mode=near (default, up to 1000 items) groups exact, normalized (case, accents, punctuation, spacing, a/an/the) and near duplicates by character 3-gram Jaccard similarity at threshold= (default 0.8, 0.3-1); mode=normalized or exact handles up to 5000 items. keep=first|longest|shortest picks the survivor. Returns unique list in original order, unique_indexes, duplicate count and percent, and groups showing each duplicate with how it matched and its similarity. Offline; good for cleaning product titles, company names, leads, RAG chunks and scraped lists. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
